name: BAIT
about: BAIT is a food and beverage supply company focused on providing everyday essentials such as bottled water, snacks, and disposable food-service supplies. We specialize in simple ordering, reliable product availability, and efficient distribution.
how_to_order: To place an order, visit the Issues tab in our GitHub repository and submit a new issue. Include the product name, product ID, quantity, and requested delivery date. Our team will review the request and confirm the order.
